entry.title: Software Engineer
entry.content:

entry.title: AI Intern
entry.content:
• Built an AI Agent for Chatwoot integrating real-time Shopify data to automate customer support across channels, improving response efficiency and enabling seamless human handoff for complex queries.

  • Fine-tuned T5 for text-to-CAD pattern generation; processed 18,000+ CAD files.
